engine.name: Kestra
engine.image_selection_reason: The official Docker Hub tag listing surfaced the full v2.0.3 image as a visible exact 2.x patch tag; availability of the v2.0.5 container image was not established by this audit. v2.0.5 is an upgrade verification item, not silently assumed.
engine.plugin_variant: Full image with bundled plugins; not slim/no-plugins

security_boundary.management_port_authentication: Configured with endpoints.all.basic-auth using local credentials; management port remains loopback-only.
security_boundary.basic_auth: Enabled; credentials generated locally from ignored .env
security_boundary.arbitrary_script_flows: Blocked from committed flow templates until an isolated runner is specified and independently reviewed
security_boundary.storage_bootstrap: One-shot container with user 0:0, network_mode none, read_only root filesystem, cap_drop ALL, cap_add CHOWN, only kestra-data volume, no Docker socket; long-running Kestra service remains non-root.

required_next_gates: Verify official v2.0.5 Docker image availability and compare its release provenance before any upgrade.
Retain the CI evidence artifact showing the exact pulled image digests and health response.
Design and test a dedicated isolated task execution boundary before enabling script-based workflows.
Review GitHub integration permissions and side-effect restrictions before connecting any repository token.
Complete independent validation and certification as separate gates; no automated certification propagation.

ci_history.observed: Workflow run recorded zero jobs and used the filename as its display name.
ci_history.response: A later commit changed the job-level EVIDENCE_DIR expression from runner.temp to github.workspace; the subsequent run loaded a named job.

ci_history.observed: Static guard passed; docker compose config --quiet failed because KESTRA_ADMIN_EMAIL was absent after malformed .env generation.
ci_history.response: Subsequent commit switched the generator to chr(10) line separators. This run did not pull images or test runtime health.

ci_history.observed: Static validation and Compose validation passed; image pull and Compose startup passed; authenticated management-health validation was still running when the workflow was updated.
ci_history.response: Configured endpoints.all.basic-auth and changed the CI check to authenticate to management health, retaining loopback binding.

ci_history.observed: Static guard and Docker Compose schema validation passed; exact image pulls and Compose startup passed; health polling had not returned and the GitHub Actions run metadata had not advanced.
ci_history.response: Added connect and total-request timeouts plus a finite 30-attempt health loop so failure is bounded and diagnostic.

ci_history.observed: The authenticated health check failed because Kestra terminated with AccessDeniedException at /app/storage/plugins. GitHub Actions also did not upload the evidence bundle because its directory name started with a dot and hidden files were excluded.
ci_history.response: Added an isolated one-shot volume permission bootstrap restricted to CHOWN, no network and no Docker socket; kept the long-running service non-root. Renamed the CI evidence directory to a non-hidden path.
